notes.text: Hyper-connections (mHC): the residual is 4 parallel streams; H_pre mixes them into the sublayer input and H_post / H_res (Sinkhorn-normalised) write back. The HC head merges the streams before the final norm.
compress_ratios: layers 0–1 sliding window only; then KV ÷4 (with lightning indexer, top-512) and KV ÷128 alternate. Layers 0–2 route experts by token hash (num_hash_layers = 3).
